estimate.method: The diligence-only Oracle estimate allocates the observed Oracle -001 spend using the gold artifact's exact visible input and retained judge-output size. The record envelope prices all 43 replay records, scales them to the reconciled $8.854735 account delta, takes the largest calibrated three-call record, and adds 25 percent. Mistral cost applies live catalog prices to retained route-check tokens. Modal cost is unavailable and remains null.

gate_rule.entry: Live account and key balances must cover the complete diligence-only Oracle -005, route, and official estimate plus 25 percent, then the separate replay-derived record envelope.
gate_rule.post_oracle: Before route preflight, the remaining balance must still cover route preflight, the complete official estimate plus 25 percent, and the record envelope.
gate_rule.official: After route preflight, require the complete official estimate plus 25 percent and the record envelope. Exact frozen slugs and prices must still match.

limitations: RewardKit 0.1.7 did not retain OpenRouter generation IDs or per-call usage; the record envelope is replay-calibrated rather than a provider guarantee.
The account key cannot access OpenRouter's management-only activity endpoint.
OpenRouter reservation behavior and hidden reasoning usage are not known before execution.
Modal cost is not included because a release-only dollar amount is unavailable.
